description: Codex's hook set. The .codex-plugin manifest's hooks field replaces the default hooks/hooks.json location, so this file is the whole registration: Stop (tagged for the gate's per-host continuation budget), SessionStart and PreCompact. Codex documents no PostToolUseFailure event, so the delegation-failure recording this plugin does elsewhere is absent here and the run's report is the only record of a degraded round.

hooks.command: P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT}}/skills/ultra-goal/scripts/goal_stop.py"; [ -f "$P" ] || exit 0; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$P" --host codex; else exec python "$P" --host codex; fi

P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT}}/skills/ultra-goal/scripts/goal_session_start.py"; [ -f "$P" ] || exit 0; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$P"; else exec python "$P"; fi

P="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT}}/skills/ultra-goal/scripts/goal_pre_compact.py"; [ -f "$P" ] || exit 0; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python3 "$P"; else exec python "$P"; fi
